identity_contract.canonical_identifier_type: City of Toronto One Address Repository ADDRESS_POINT_ID
identity_contract.address_id_role: Related municipal address identifier retained as an attribute; not used as TowerSignal canonical key in this phase.
identity_contract.link_fields: ADDRESS_POINT_ID_LINK and ADDRESS_ID_LINK are retained as explicit City-provided relationships and are not assumed to be ownership/parcel-parent relationships.
identity_contract.legacy_geo_id: Toronto building-permit GEO_ID values were empirically verified to correspond to current ADDRESS_POINT_ID where the historical identifier remains current. Legacy values are retained for provenance/backward mapping.
identity_contract.tower_semantics: Property identity never creates or upgrades cooling-tower confirmation.
identity_contract.canonical_address_rule: Canonicalize only the civic-address segment before the first comma; valid street-name tokens YORK/TORONTO are never stripped.
